summary: Customer developing hot polymer extrusion with an active pharmaceutical ingredient wants to know if an optical measurement can detect composition changes in the melt during processing. They have offline assays, note the process interface is hot and may be exposed to material build-up, and request an initial comparison plan and the questions required before choosing a probe.
